defect: parameterized sign extension can resemble an accidental width mismatch
rationale: The feed-through branch is selected when widths match; otherwise exactly OutWidth-InWidth copies of the input MSB are prepended. The initialization check states the required parameter relation.

provenance.adaptation: Retained both legal generate branches and the width relation check in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: A width-dependent generate branch intentionally replicates the sign bit to form the wider output.
